import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

def mat(name, col):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs[0].default_value = col
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.7
    m.diffuse_color = col
    return m

wood = mat("Wood", (0.45, 0.26, 0.12, 1))
wood2 = mat("Wood Dark", (0.30, 0.16, 0.07, 1))

def build(name, boxes, loc, rot_z=0.0, m=wood):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for (cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz) in boxes:
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=Matrix.Translation((cx, cy, cz)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((sx, sy, sz, 1)))
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    old = bpy.data.objects.get(name)
    if old: bpy.data.objects.remove(old)
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.location = loc; ob.rotation_euler.z = rot_z
    me.materials.append(m)
    return ob

# Table: 1.6 x 1.0 top at 0.75
tb = [(0, 0, 0.73, 1.6, 1.0, 0.05)]
for x in (-0.72, 0.72):
    for y in (-0.42, 0.42):
        tb.append((x, y, 0.355, 0.07, 0.07, 0.71))
tb += [(0, -0.42, 0.65, 1.37, 0.03, 0.1), (0, 0.42, 0.65, 1.37, 0.03, 0.1),
       (-0.72, 0, 0.65, 0.03, 0.77, 0.1), (0.72, 0, 0.65, 0.03, 0.77, 0.1)]
build("Table", tb, (0, 0, 0))

# Chair local: seat centered, back at +Y (away from table); chair faces -Y
ch = [(0, 0, 0.45, 0.45, 0.45, 0.04)]
for x in (-0.19, 0.19):
    for y in (-0.19, 0.19):
        ch.append((x, y, 0.215, 0.04, 0.04, 0.43))
for x in (-0.19, 0.19):
    ch.append((x, 0.19, 0.7, 0.04, 0.04, 0.46))
ch += [(0, 0.19, 0.82, 0.42, 0.03, 0.14), (0, 0.19, 0.62, 0.42, 0.03, 0.05)]

# positions: chair faces toward table center
spots = [((0, -0.85, 0), math.pi), ((0, 0.85, 0), 0.0), ((-1.15, 0, 0), math.pi/2), ((1.15, 0, 0), -math.pi/2)]
for i, (loc, r) in enumerate(spots, 1):
    build(f"Chair {i}", ch, loc, r, wood2)
print("ok")
